log.vectorsPaused: Sticker vector computing paused: {exc}; retrying in {backoff:.0f} s

descriptionEmpty: The sticker description can't be empty
noCaption: The sticker description model returned no description
judgeInvalid: The sticker judging model didn't return valid JSON
full: The sticker library is full. Delete some stickers in the WebUI first.
imageLimits: Stickers must be PNG, JPEG, GIF, or WebP images up to 2 MB

tools.refOtherSession: The image reference doesn't belong to this session
tools.imageExpired: The image expired or isn't a supported image
tools.missing: The sticker doesn't exist. Find its ID with meme_search first.
tools.sendHint: Send one of them with <meme>ID</meme>; description is the text the description model wrote.
tools.search: Search the sticker library by meaning and return sticker IDs, categories, and text descriptions; can be limited to a category. Once you find a good sticker, send it by writing <meme>ID</meme> in your reply.
tools.view: View the image of a sticker in the library (id from meme_search). Only works for models that accept images; other models get an error, so read the text description from meme_search instead.
tools.save: Save an image received in this session (the ref in [image ref=...]) to the sticker library. Leave category empty to choose one automatically, and description empty to let the description model write it.
